title: Figure 13: Time-domain balanced homodyne detector circuit schematic
description: Optical and electronic schematic showing polarizing beam splitter (PBS) cubes, a 50:50 beam splitter (BS), two λ/2 half-wave plates and two photodiodes biased at +12V and -12V, feeding amplifier stages labeled A250 and A275 with "pole zero differentiation" and "low pass filter" blocks to an OUT terminal. Caption reads "Figure 13. Time-Domain Balanced Homodyne Detector. (courtesy of P. Lodahl)."
